# Privacy Policy — Gobblo

_Last updated: [DATE]_

Gobblo ("the app") is made by [YOUR FULL NAME], [CITY], Morocco. Contact: [SUPPORT EMAIL].

**The short version: your tasks stay on your phone.**

## What we collect
- **Your tasks, pet and stats** are stored only on your device. Ads never see your tasks. We don't have servers that receive them, and we can't see them.
- **No account.** The app has no sign-up or login.
- **Ads (Android only).** The Android app shows ads through Google AdMob, mostly optional "watch to earn" videos. AdMob may collect device identifiers (such as the advertising ID), approximate location from your IP address, and app usage data to show and measure ads. Where the law requires it (e.g. EU/UK), we ask for your consent first, and you can change it in Settings > Privacy options. See Google's policy: https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites. The iPhone app has no ads and no tracking.
- **Purchases (iPhone/iPad only):** if you buy Gobblo Plus, Apple processes the payment. We use RevenueCat to check what you have bought. RevenueCat receives an anonymous app ID and your purchase history, not your name or card details. See revenuecat.com/privacy.
- **Crash reports** [KEEP ONLY IF ENABLED]: if the app crashes, anonymous technical info (device model, OS version, error) may be sent to [EAS Observe / Sentry] so we can fix bugs.
- **Notifications** are scheduled on your device. We don't send them from a server.

## Your choices
- Turn notifications off or change the nudge level in Settings.
- Export your data (Settings > Backup) or delete everything (Settings > Reset). Deleting the app also deletes all its data.

## Children
Gobblo is not directed to children under 13.

## Health
Gobblo is a productivity and habit app. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition.

## Changes
If this policy changes, we'll update the date above and the in-app link.

_Template only, not legal advice. Have it reviewed before you rely on it._
